label: Full Stack Developer
weeks: Setup & Git workflow :: Install Node, VS Code, Git. Create a GitHub repo and push a Hello World with 5 meaningful commits.

Authentication :: Implement signup/login with hashed passwords and JWT. Submit working endpoints and demo video.

File upload :: Add image upload for posts (Supabase storage or Cloudinary) with size/type validation.
Search, pagination & filters :: Implement server-side pagination and search on the posts list.
Testing :: Write at least 8 unit/API tests (Jest/Vitest) and report coverage.
Security & performance review :: Fix 5 issues: input validation, CORS, rate limit, env secrets, image optimisation. Document changes.
Deployment :: Deploy frontend (Vercel) and backend (Render/Railway) with environment variables. Submit live links.
Capstone build :: Build the final full-stack app (your own idea, approved by mentor) with auth, CRUD and roles.
Documentation :: Write a README with setup steps, API docs, screenshots and architecture diagram.
Final demo :: Record a 5-minute walkthrough video and present the project to the mentor. Submit video link and feedback notes.
